title: Optional private PostgreSQL18 cohort preserves acquisition and process custody
question: Does one explicitly acquired pg_virtualenv host serve the selected ordinary cohort with real purpose credentials, preserved selection/context, and supervised teardown?
method: Inspect installed postgresql-common294, implement one wrapper under the existing receipt supervisor, normalize creation inputs, bootstrap extension-ready owner-matched infrastructure and canonical restricted purpose roles, then execute real multiworker driver, SQL-family, controlled startup failure, managed retry and interruption selections. Pure controls assess environment/path containment, incompatibility, mode and child-owner gates independently.

conclusion: The optional private route acquired one PostgreSQL18.7 host per selected cohort, served both infrastructure workers with real restricted-purpose authenticated identities, and executed the complete nineteen-case SQL family. Parent PG routing/auth/configuration inputs did not redirect creation/acquisition. Actual controlled preload failure retained bounded native diagnostics and removed the owned host. Managed retry preserved private mode and executed on a new observed port/start/system identity; failed history remains visible. SIGINT during an active database query produced an interrupted/incomplete case with no functional pass while child groups settled, logs were copied, external temporary data was removed and the private endpoint closed. Unconfirmed custody deliberately retains the owned external host/data and remains unsettled; no crash-proof/SIGKILL or durability claim is made. The shared default driver route passes. Actual Rust-inside-private execution was not run; each existing Rust/Python process-owner drain gate and execution-PATH preservation received focused controls. Global final formatting, integrated source applicability and TS-23 qualification remain with the coordinator. No persistent database deployment, production DDO change, shared-port provisioning or earlier frozen artifact change occurred.
